name: Remakes Analysis
query:
SELECT
 reason AS "Reason::160",
 responsibility AS "Responsibility::130",
 COUNT(*) AS "Remakes:Int:90",
 SUM(CASE WHEN warranty_covered = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Under Warranty:Int:120",
 SUM(IFNULL(cost, 0)) AS "Total Cost:Currency:110"
FROM `tabOptical Remake`
WHERE status != 'Rejected'
GROUP BY reason, responsibility
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
